snippet.title: Solis | official trailer
snippet.description:
Solis is a hand-drawn adventure game about technology and deception in an atmospheric city at night.

Wishlist and download the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3382310/Solis/

In the game you explore an atmospheric and compact open world. Decisions within the game carry weight, influencing subsequent events, while the in-game text adjusts to reflect your choices. The game is build using hand drawn graphics and animations and DIY music. The game subtly explores themes like the platform economy, wealth gap and the impact of digital technologies on our lifes.  

Story:
From dusk till dawn you navigate the hand drawn city of Solis. Your pursuit is focused on the elusive CEO of eLiXiR, the company you work for. eliXiR promises something incredible: eternal life. As Billie; a marketeer, you've effectively sold this vision to the public, yet the truth behind your employer remains shrouded in mystery. Throughout your journey, you'll encounter a myriad of individuals with diverse perspectives, ultimately leading you to forge your own beliefs. Will you remain loyal to eLiXiR or come out with the truth?

https://www.solis-game.com

2026
